notes: Moves files of the library to another folder: who sees them changes with the folder. On the drive they go into the same day's folder in the other folder's directory, with a number added where a name is taken there (IMG_0001 (2).jpg). changed counts the files that moved; files already in that folder or not in the library are left alone. The files keep their id and updated_at, so thumbnails stay cached. At most 1000 ids per request (bad_request); send more in parts. 404 not_found for no such folder. Encrypted files need keys: [{"id", "version", "key"}], their file keys sealed for the target folder's newest key; 409 key_outdated without them, 409 not_encrypted into a folder that was never encrypted.
